# Stouls Studio

> Interior architecture studio in Paris run by Margaux Stouls. For buyers based in the United States and Canada: apartment sourcing, design, renovation management and furnishing, for a rental investment or a pied-à-terre.

- [Buy and renovate an apartment in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/): Margaux Stouls, interior architect in Paris, finds your apartment, draws the plans, runs the renovation and furnishes it while you stay in the US or Canada. Rental investment or pied-à-terre.
- [Services: from apartment search to handover | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/services/): Two ways to work with interior architect Margaux Stouls in Paris: from the apartment search to the keys, or the turnkey renovation of an apartment you already own.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from abroad | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/apartment-search-paris/): Looking at apartments for sale in Paris from the US or Canada? An interior architect searches, visits them for you and tells you what each one could become before you make an offer.
- [Paris apartment renovation, managed for you | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation/): Design, technical file, materials, site follow-up and furnishing for your Paris apartment, run by interior architect Margaux Stouls from the first plan to the keys.
- [A pied-à-terre in Paris, found and renovated | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-pied-a-terre/): Your own apartment in Paris, found, renovated and furnished by an interior architect while you are at home. Arrive to a finished place.
- [English-speaking interior architect in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/about/): Margaux Stouls founded Stouls Studio in Paris in 2019. She designs and manages apartment renovations, and works with owners based in North America.
- [Portfolio of interior architect Margaux Stouls | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/): Full and partial renovations by Stouls Studio in Paris and beyond: apartments, rental studios and second homes, plus custom furniture, 3D visualisations and drawings.
- [Apartment, Paris 9th | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-paris-9/): A dark, badly laid-out apartment redrawn so that light crosses it from one side to the other. Paris, 9th arrondissement. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Studio Mazarine, Paris 6th | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/studio-mazarine/): A 24 m² studio rebuilt to hold a real kitchen, a table to eat at, a living room and a sleeping area set apart from all three. Paris, 6th arrondissement. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls
- [Studio, Saint-Germain-des-Prés | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/studio-saint-germain-des-pres/): A small apartment under the roof, renovated entirely and laid out as a real one-room home. Paris, Saint-Germain-des-Prés. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Montmartre | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-montmartre/): Twenty-six square metres in Montmartre, renovated from A to Z and shown twice: as drawn in three dimensions, and as built. Paris 18th, Montmartre. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Levallois-Perret | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-levallois/): A 55 m² apartment bought to be renovated and sold, designed around its marble fireplace and its old parquet. Levallois-Perret, west of Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Levallois-Perret II | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-levallois-2/): A second apartment in Levallois-Perret, kept pale and calm, with colour saved for the joinery. Levallois-Perret, west of Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Boulogne-Billancourt | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-boulogne/): Black cabinets, warm wood and an old pine floor in an apartment on the edge of Paris. Boulogne-Billancourt, west of Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Country house, Burgundy | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/country-house-burgundy/): A 130 m² house in Burgundy that gained comfort without losing what made it an old country house. Burgundy, France. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [House on Sifnos | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/house-sifnos/): A jazz club that everyone on the island knew, turned into a 150 m² holiday house. Sifnos, Greece. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment with mezzanine, Montparnasse | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/mezzanine-apartment-montparnasse/): A partial renovation with one subject: the library, and the storage a double-height room was missing. Paris, Montparnasse. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Apartment, Meudon | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/portfolio/apartment-meudon/): Several rooms of a large apartment reworked through joinery made to measure. Meudon, south-west of Paris. Designed by interior architect Margaux Stouls.
- [Paris rental investment: what is allowed | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-rental-investment/): Short tourist lets of a second home are all but closed in Paris. What still works, the energy-rating rules, and how an interior architect finds and builds a rental apartment for you.
- [Can Americans buy an apartment in Paris? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/guide/buying-renovating-paris-apartment/): The purchase steps, the costs on top of the price, building approvals, energy ratings, rental rules and taxes to ask your adviser about, each with its official source.
- [Paris property glossary in plain English | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of the French words in a Paris apartment purchase and renovation: notaire, compromis, copropriété, syndic, DPE, loi Carrez, chambre de bonne, pied-à-terre.
- [What is a pied-à-terre? Meaning and pronunciation | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/pied-a-terre/): A pied-à-terre is a small second home in a city, kept for short stays. Meaning, pronunciation, plural, and what owning one in Paris involves.
- [What is a Haussmann apartment? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/haussmann-apartment/): A Haussmann (Haussmannian) apartment is in one of the cut-stone buildings from the rebuilding of Paris, 1853 to 1870. How to recognise one, its layout, and what a renovation changes.
- [What is a chambre de bonne? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/chambre-de-bonne/): A chambre de bonne is a former servant's room under the roof of a Paris building, usually 6 to 12 m². What it is, the legal minimum size to rent one, and what can be done with it.
- [Copropriété and syndic explained | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/copropriete-syndic/): A copropriété is a building owned in shares by its apartment owners. The syndic is the manager they appoint. What each does, what you pay, and what they decide about your renovation.
- [Paris apartment renovation cost per m² | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation-cost/): What Paris firms publish for renovation cost per m², from a refresh to a full premium renovation, why two apartments of the same size differ, and the costs on top of the contractor's quote.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from Canada | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/canadian-buyers-paris/): Stouls Studio's first overseas clients were Canadian. How a Canadian buyer finds, buys, renovates and furnishes a Paris apartment without being on site, in English or French.
- [Legal notice and privacy | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/legal/): Who publishes stoulsstudio.com: company name, registration, registered office, publication director, host, and how personal data is handled.
